page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-8 is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core. The instance is configured with 32 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware. The CPU architecture supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and cryptographic acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA_NI.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core performance ranking in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance, software compilation, and database operations fall within the average range. However, memory bandwidth benchmarks reveal a performance bottleneck, with uncached large-block read and write speeds scoring in the bottom 25%. Similarly, while the instance handles small-model LLM inference adequately, text generation for medium 7B models is poor, placing in the bottom 10%.

The c3d-standard-8 offers a balanced resource profile suitable for general-purpose workloads. Its dedicated AMD EPYC cores provide reliable compute density, though the weak uncached memory bandwidth represents a notable tradeoff for memory-intensive applications. This instance is best suited for workloads such as static web serving, standard database operations, software compilation, and general-purpose application hosting where extreme memory throughput is not a primary requirement.
